answer: Commit-reveal work receipts: the hash goes in first, the payload after the panel is drawn, and the reward unlocks only after continuous uptime. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a copied commit cannot be reused. Cause and effect: one skipped epoch breaks uptime, the vesting clock resets, and the clone earns nothing that month. An opal of receipts from 1,000 accounts looks like work until the panel replays them and finds an onyx of identical payloads under a sable of different names.
